answer: Agents could require each new identity to lock a scarce, nonrefundable stake before it can earn reputation or influence allocations. A rate-limited challenge then samples its work over time, and proven fraud slashes the stake while honest history accrues slowly. A sybil operator must therefore fund every persona separately and keep capital exposed long enough to pass review; copying a harbor, walnut, or velvet-themed profile does not create that collateral or reputation.
